dedupe_keys.name: weather forcing manifests and reproducibility package for urban heat island building simulations in turin 2014 2023

description: Ali JahaniRahaei and collaborators publish weather-forcing manifests, compact EnergyPlus outputs and analysis scripts for Turin urban-heat-island building experiments covering 2014–2023. The September 2026 deposit is publicly downloadable under CC BY 4.0. It contains matched-year and typical-weather provenance, validation records, lag and persistent-heat analyses, and derived response tables. These materials can audit or recalculate climate-sensitive building simulations. The outputs describe useful thermal needs of an archetypal DOE–TABULA model, not measured consumption or a calibrated occupied building. Related catalogue record data-torino-urban-weather-epw-2014-2023 covers the separately deposited source weather. Raw EnergyPlus run directories and some controlled weather and model variants are omitted and available only by enquiry. The README retains stale prepublication text, while the live deposit is public. Absolute paths are historical provenance, not portable file locations. Uncertainty, completeness and reported results were not independently checked.
